mn143:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn143:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
mn143:2.2: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati aññataram purisaṃ āmantesi:--
mn143:2.3: Ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā mama vacanena Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi evañ ca vadehi:
mn143:2.4: Anāthapiṇḍiko, bhante, gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno,
mn143:2.6: Yena c' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṃkama upasaṃkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato Sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandāhi evañ ca vadehi:
mn143:2.10: Sādhu kira, bhante, āyasmā Sāriputto yena Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn143:2.11: Evaṃ bhante ti kho so puriso Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn143:2.12: Anāthapiṇḍiko, bhante, gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno;
mn143:2.14: Yena c' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca:
mn143:2.15: Anāthapiṇḍiko, bhante, gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno;
mn143:2.16: so āyasmato Sāriputtassa pāde sirasā vandati
mn143:2.18: Sādhu kira, bhante, āyasmā Sāriputto yena Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
mn143:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya āyasmatā Ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena Anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho āyasmā Sāriputto Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca:
mn143:3.2: Kacci te, gahapati, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamo 'sānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo ti?
mn143:4.1: Na me, bhante Sāriputta, khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ; bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamo 'sānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo.
mn143:4.2: Seyyathāpi, bhante Sāriputta, balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena . . . (&c. as Vol. II.
mn143:4.3: p. 193, line 1 to line 23) . . . no paṭikkamo
mn143:5.2: Na cakkhuṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:5.5: Na sotaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me sotanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:6.9: Na dhammaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me dhammanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:7.2: Na cakkhuviññāṇaṃ upādiyissami, na ca me cakkhuviññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:7.9: Na manoviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manoviññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:8.2: Na cakkhusamphassaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhusamphassanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:8.9: Na manosamphassaṃ viññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manosamphassanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:9.2: Na cakkhusamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me cakkhusamphassajaṃ vedanānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:9.9: Na manosamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manosamphassajaṃ vedanānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:10.2: Na paṭhavīdhātuṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me paṭhavīdhātunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:10.9: Na viññāṇadhātuṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me viññāṇadhātunissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:11.2: Na rūpaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me rūpanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:11.8: Na viññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me viññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:12.2: Na ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me ākāsānañcāyatananissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:12.7: Na nevasaññānāsaññāyatanānaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me nevasaññānāsaññānissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:13.2: Na idhalokaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me idhalokanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:14.2: Na paralokaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me paralokanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:14.5: Yam p' idaṃ diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam pi na upādiyissāmi na ca me tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn143:15.1: Evaṃ vutte Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati parodi assūni pavattesi.
mn143:15.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca:--
mn143:15.3: Olīyasi kho tvaṃ, gahapati, saṃsīdasi kho tvaṃ gahapatīti?
mn143:15.4: Nāhaṃ, bhante Ānanda, olīyāmi, na saṃsīdami.
mn143:15.5: Api me dīgharattaṃ Satthā payirupāsito, manobhāvanīyo ca bhikkhū,
mn143:15.6: na ca me evarūpī dhammī kathā sutapubbā ti.
mn143:15.7: Na kho, gahapati, gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ evarūpi dhammī kathā paṭibhāti.
mn143:15.8: Pabbajitānaṃ kho, gahapati, evarūpī dhammī kathā paṭibhātīti.
mn143:15.9: Tena hi, bhante Sāriputta, gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ evarūpī dhammī kathā paṭibhātu.
mn143:15.10: Santi hi, bhante Sāriputta, kulaputtā apparajakkhajātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti,
mn143:16.1: Atha kho āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Ānando Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā pakkamiṃsu.
mn143:16.2: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati acirapakkante āyasmante ca Sāriputte āyasmante ca Ānande kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Tusitaṃ kāyaṃ uppajji.
mn143:17.1: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
mn143:17.2: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:--
mn143:18.4: Samanuñño me Satthā ti Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi.
mn143:19.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn143:19.2: Imaṃ, bhikkhave, rattiṃ aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
mn143:19.3: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho so devaputto maṃ gāthāhi ajjhābhāsi:--
mn143:19.21: Samanuñño me Satthā ti maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyīti.
mn143:20.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn143:20.2: So hi nūna so, bhante, Anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhavissati;
mn143:20.3: Anāthapiṇḍiko, bhante, gahapati āyasmante Sāriputte aveccappasanno ahosīti.
mn143:20.5: Yāvatakaṃ kho, Ānanda, takkāya pattabbaṃ, anuppattaṃ tayā.
mn143:20.6: Anāthapiṇḍiko so, Ānanda, devaputto n' añño ti.
mn143:20.8: Attamano āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 144.
